svg.aria-label: A railway yard seen from the front. A document wagon runs left to right along one line through, in order: a stamp that rewrites values (Transformation Rules), a matcher that pins an invoice bar to an order bar (Purchase Order Matching Rules), the same stamp again, and a loading gauge (Custom Validation Rules). A signal beyond it shows Ready for validation, and the wagon rests just past it. Then the line splits at a points lever: straight under a chain of three linked cards (Standard Workflow), or onto a siding that forks (Advanced Workflow). A cabinet of cards with one custom card half out stands behind (Workflow SDK card). A rail of trigger posts along the back of the first half stands for Scripts.
